title: Family Day Picture Song
hook: Choose tasks by age, ability, time, and care.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D daily-routine storybook, simple home actions and objects, clean morning-evening scenes; visual identity: Family Day Picture Song

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child in a flexible family/household routine
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Family Day Picture Song about shared routines without gender roles: meals, packing, clothing, hygiene, rest and preparation can be distributed by age, ability, schedule and preference; family forms vary.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sees a day supported by cooperation and choice rather than a mother/father job script.
